question: Tara has collected 232 bottle caps, which she keeps in a dozen glass jars. Her sister Uma has 9 times as many bottle caps as Tara, so Uma's collection is much larger. Over the summer Uma found 40 caps at the beach, 32 caps at a festival, and 36 caps behind the corner shop. She then handed 1954 caps over to a recycling drive. How many bottle caps does Uma have now?

At eight o'clock there were 52 cars in the stadium car park. Over the next hour 72 cars arrived, and then 98 cars left when the morning event finished. Later 15 cars arrived for the afternoon session, 11 cars left before the break, and another 16 cars left after it. The car park has 2 entrances. How many cars are in the car park now?

In the morning at Sana's coffee cart, 8 regulars each left a tip of 112 cents in the jar. A tourist then dropped in 79 cents and a delivery driver added 50 cents. In the afternoon Sana took 30 cents out of the jar for a parking meter and paid 456 cents from it for a sandwich. In the evening a customer put in 3 cents of change. Sana counts her tips in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents are in the tip jar at the end of the evening?

Xavier and Yara entered an arcade tournament, one of a dozen held in the city that year. Their team's 141 tokens were shared equally among 3 players, and Xavier was one of them. Xavier used 37 of his tokens on the racing game and then lost 3 tokens down a drain, so at that point he held fewer tokens than Yara, who had been more careful with hers. In the bonus round every token Xavier still held was worth 9 points, and a penalty for a late finish then took 20 points away. How many points did Xavier end with?

In the morning a wholesale market received a shipment of rice: each pallet held a 69-kilogram sack and a 50-kilogram sack, there were 4 pallets in each truck, and 8 trucks arrived. The warehouse is 20 kilometres from the port. In the afternoon 3587 kilograms of the rice were sold to restaurants. In the evening the manager sold all of the remaining rice to a single buyer at 4 dollars per kilogram, plus a delivery charge of 77 dollars. He weighs rice in kilograms rather than grams, since one thousand grams make a kilogram. How many dollars did the buyer pay in total?

Zack had 108 minutes of talk time left on his phone plan. He used 85 minutes on a call to his grandmother and another 6 minutes calling a taxi. His sister Ava, one of a dozen cousins in the family group chat, had 5 times as many minutes left as Zack did after those calls, so Ava was much better off. Ava then used 74 minutes on a work call and 3 minutes confirming a dentist appointment. The plan shows the balance in minutes rather than hours, and sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of talk time does Ava have left?

In the morning Cleo picked 173 cherries from the tree in her garden and handed 139 of them over the fence to her neighbour. In the afternoon she picked 42 more cherries. Her brother Dev, who had been picking at the orchard all day, came home with triple the number of cherries Cleo had at that point, so Dev had far more than his sister. In the evening Dev sold 119 of his cherries at the roadside stand. How many cherries does Dev have now?

Emma has 14 merit badges on her sash. Her friend Felix has twice as many badges as Emma, so Felix is ahead of her. Over the year Felix earned 66 badges at summer camp, 37 badges for community service, and another 37 badges for his hiking challenge. He then decided to divide all of his badges equally among the 6 members of his new patrol, one of whom is Gus. How many badges did Gus receive?

In the morning Iris checked the bus fare, which is 153 cents per trip, and found that her student card takes 34 cents off every trip. She makes 7 trips a week. In the afternoon she decided to load her card for twice that long, 2 whole weeks of trips. In the evening she topped up the card, which charges a 57-cent fee for the top-up. She counts in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents did the top-up cost her altogether?

In the morning Jo had a 156-minute shift ahead of her, of which 121 minutes were booked for meetings. She split the remaining time equally into 5 short breaks. In the afternoon she took 5 breaks of exactly that length. In the evening she worked out that she would keep to the same break pattern on each of the next 9 working days. She measures breaks in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make an hour. How many minutes of breaks will Jo take over those 9 days?

Ken's pear orchard produced 7 crates of pears with 169 pears in each crate, which was more than his neighbour Lars managed from his whole orchard that season. Ken then found 12 pears that had fallen into the grass and picked 69 more from a late tree. He sold 106 pears to a jam maker and afterwards picked 51 more from the last row. He then sold every pear he had at the wholesale market for 5 cents each. How many cents did Ken receive at the wholesale market?

A granola bar weighs 71 grams, and the bars are sold in packs of 5, with 8 packs to a box. The cardboard of each box adds another 77 grams to it. A shop ordered 6 of those boxes, and the courier added a 22-gram address label to the shipment. The drive from the warehouse to the shop takes 40 minutes. The warehouse records weights in grams rather than kilograms, and one thousand grams make a kilogram. How many grams does the whole shipment weigh?

On a typical weekday Quentin has 59 minutes of free time after school. This term his bus route changed, giving him 15 minutes more each weekday, and a cancelled club gave him another 51 minutes. He then took on a 105-minute tutoring session each weekday, and he also spends 5 minutes every weekday feeding the cat, both of which come out of his free time. He plans his free time in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour, and he thinks a dozen minutes is barely enough for anything. There are 5 weekdays in a school week. How many minutes of free time does Quentin have in a school week?

Tess mailed a parcel weighing 95 grams. Her brother Uli's parcel weighed twice as much as Tess's, so Uli's was the heavier one, and after he added 14 grams of tape it was heavier still. Uli then made up 8 parcels of exactly that same weight for his customers, put them all in one crate, and stuck a 5-gram label on the crate. At the depot, items weighing 1169 grams in total were removed from the crate because they were not allowed in the post, and everything that remained, label included, was repacked equally into 3 smaller boxes. Uli records weights in grams rather than kilograms, though he knows one thousand grams make a kilogram. How many grams did one of those 3 boxes hold?

Willa's bakery makes 3 batches of cookies every working day, with 177 cookies in each batch, and then adds a single extra batch of 44 cookies for the staff room. That daily total is more cookies than Xena's bakery across the street manages in a whole week. Willa's bakery works 3 days each week and keeps to the same daily output every working day. The current contract with the supermarket runs for 8 weeks. How many cookies will Willa's bakery make over the contract?

In the morning the tour company checked its coaches: each coach has 82 seats, but 8 seats on every coach were taken out for luggage racks, and 7 coaches were assigned to the festival. A minibus fleet with 77 seats in total was added to the same booking. The festival site is 120 kilometres from the city. In the afternoon 530 of the seats were sold to fans. In the evening the company sold every remaining seat at a last-minute price of 4 dollars each. How many dollars did the company take from the last-minute sales?

Yuki had 235 cents in her pocket, spent 194 cents on a bus ticket, and then found 20 cents on the floor of the bus. Her brother Zane had 4 times as many cents as Yuki had after that, so Zane was the richer of the two. Zane then earned 73 cents returning bottles and 63 cents sweeping a neighbour's path, which took him about a dozen minutes. Zane counts his money in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents does Zane have now?

In the morning a crate of 132 oranges was divided equally into 3 baskets, one for each of the market's 3 fruit stalls, and Ben's stall received its basket. Later in the morning Ben added 33 oranges from his own garden to his stall. In the afternoon Ben sold 76 oranges to customers. In the evening a farmer dropped off 73 more oranges at Ben's stall. How many oranges does Ben's stall have now?

Fay ordered 5 boxes of candles with 66 candles in each box and split them equally among her 3 shops. Each shop sold all of its candles at 6 dollars apiece, and the money from the High Street shop was divided equally among its 4 partners. The candles are 20 centimetres tall. Gil, one of those partners, then received a 79-dollar bonus on top of his share. How many dollars did Gil receive in total?

A warehouse received 8 pallets, each stacked with 128 boxes of tiles, and put them all in the loading bay. Over the week the bay shipped out 729 boxes to a builder, 167 boxes to a hardware store, and 118 boxes to a hotel. The boxes still in the bay were then spread equally across 5 shelves. On Friday a delivery of 33 boxes was placed on the top shelf. How many boxes are on the top shelf now?

Jack had 77 dollars in his wallet. His sister Kira had triple the amount Jack had, so Kira was the better off of the two. Kira spent 70 dollars on a concert ticket and 128 dollars on a coat. She then earned 9 dollars returning bottles and spent 34 dollars on a birthday present. Kira keeps track in dollars rather than cents, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many dollars does Kira have now?

In the morning the school canteen received 7 boxes of doughnuts with 14 doughnuts in each box, and then a second supplier dropped off 67 more doughnuts. In the afternoon a parent baked 35 doughnuts for the bake sale and added them to the pile. In the evening 114 doughnuts were sold at the school concert. How many doughnuts were left after the concert?

A bus left the depot with 71 passengers on board. At the first stop 14 passengers got off, at the second stop 16 got off, and at the third stop 36 got off. The bus has 3 doors. At the fourth stop 20 passengers got on, at the fifth stop 44 got on, and at the sixth stop 4 got off. How many passengers are on the bus now?

Every day at the pool, which has a dozen lanes, Otto swims 178 metres as a warm-up, then adds 75 metres of backstroke and another 75 metres of front crawl to his session, which is farther than his friend Pam swims in a day. He keeps to exactly that daily session on each of the 7 days of the week. This week, on Sunday, he also swam an extra 19 metres to finish a race with Pam. How many metres did Otto swim this week?

In the archive's new storage system, each folder holds 143 scanned pages, a project is made of 7 folders plus a 25-page index that is stored alongside them. Each drive stores 8 such projects, each rack holds 8 drives, and the server room has 8 racks. The room is 30 metres long, and the archivist has worked there for a dozen years. How many scanned pages does the server room hold in total?
